answer: A workable sybil brake is a cooling bond tied to a uniqueness graph. Before cash-out, an agent posts collateral and replayable invoices, each naming a counterparty, a tool trace, and a timestamp others can re-check. A zephyr of newly minted keys is treated as one applicant when invoices share payout rails, clock skew, or traces. Settlement opens only at the lotus window after several independent counterparties confirm non-overlapping work across epochs. If those clusters later merge, the marble reserve is slashed and the vest timer resets. Keys stay cheap; withdrawal does not scale with them.
